_why: Transcripts whose table numbers check_table_numbers.py cannot find in the PDF the site declares as their source. All three have the SAME cause and it is not a transcription error: the prose was transcribed from one edition of the paper and the tables from another, so no single PDF contains both. Recorded here rather than tolerated silently, so the gate still fails the moment a NEW one appears. Each entry says what was measured. Whether to re-transcribe the tables from the declared edition, or to declare the other edition as the source, is the owner's decision and is written up in the memo -- it is not a fix that should be made quietly, because it changes what the page presents.
climate: Prose matches climate2.pdf (the published article) on 82% of sampled sentences but only 3% of its table numbers; climate_sensitivity.pdf (the 18-page working paper) carries 100% of them. 46 of 50 table tokens are absent from the declared source.
dst: Prose matches dst2.pdf on 68% of sampled sentences but only 8% of its table numbers; dst.pdf carries 100%. 454 of 573 table tokens are absent from the declared source. This is the largest instance.
dst_slovakia: Only 8 of 972 tokens, but the same cause: the years 1962, 1977, 1986, 1987 and 1988 and the counts 17,200 and 55,000 in Table 10 appear in dst_slovakia.pdf and not in dst_slovakia_manuscript.pdf, which is the declared source.
